metadata.reportTitle: ARUI Comprehensive Verification, Adversarial Testing & Validation Preparation Report

knownLimitations: Empirical reliability and validity coefficients require live empirical pilot dataset collection (as defined in Part Q/R/S).
Optional advanced student sampling (D03 A09) is executed as an assessment card, distinct from standard Q01-Q09 diagnostic questions.
summary.recommendedNextAction: Proceed with controlled empirical pilot validation with representative university cohorts.

tests.test: Resource Separation Invariant: Inst A (Low Resources) vs Inst B (High Resources) Capability Scores
tests.expected: Score A (75%) === Score B (75%)

tests.test: Required Maturity is Diagnostic & Context Sensitive
tests.expected: Required maturity responds to context variables (P0-4)
tests.actual: Inst A Req Mat: 3 | Inst B Req Mat: 3

tests.test: Case 1: High Capability (100%) with 0 Evidence -> Confidence is unverified
tests.expected: evidenceConfidence: unverified
tests.evidence: High score alone does not grant High evidence confidence

tests.test: Case 2: High Capability with Submitted Direct Evidence -> Confidence is preliminary
tests.expected: evidenceConfidence: preliminary

tests.test: Case 4: High Capability with 6+ Reviewed Items -> Confidence is corroborated
tests.expected: evidenceConfidence: corroborated

tests.test: Evidence Decoupling Rule: Capability Score Unaltered by Evidence Status (100.00%)
tests.evidence: Evidence confidence is a separate dimension from capability score

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG01: Policy-only inflation (INPUT: M=4 with E1 only -> ENGINE: flag AG01, cap confidence)
tests.expected: AG01 flagged, evidence confidence capped below corroborated
tests.actual: AG01 detected and flagged; confidence unverified/preliminary
tests.evidence: Policy alone cannot unlock corroborated status without operational E2+ proof

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG02: Self-authored corroboration (INPUT: 3 artifacts from single source -> ENGINE: flag AG02)
tests.expected: AG02 flagged for single source origin
tests.actual: AG02 detected: multiple artifacts share 1 origin
tests.evidence: Self-authored items count as 1 source origin

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG03: Evidence recycling (INPUT: 1 artifact linked across 6 domains -> ENGINE: flag AG03)
tests.expected: AG03 flagged for broad construct recycling
tests.actual: AG03 detected: artifact linked across 6 distinct domains
tests.evidence: Over-recycled evidence flagged under primary-owner restriction

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG04: Cherry-picked outcomes (INPUT: Selective elite sample -> ENGINE: flag AG04)
tests.expected: AG04 flagged for non-representative outcome claim
tests.actual: AG04 active and recorded in assessment audit

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG05: Duplicate evidence (INPUT: Identical SHA-256 hash -> ENGINE: flag AG05)
tests.expected: AG05 flagged for duplicate hash
tests.actual: AG05 detected: duplicate file hash across distinct submissions

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG06: Cross-construct artifact reuse (INPUT: Mismatched construct link -> ENGINE: flag AG06)
tests.expected: AG06 flagged for construct mismatch

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG07: Selective student sampling (INPUT: Non-representative survey -> ENGINE: flag AG07)
tests.expected: AG07 flagged for selective sampling

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG08: Expired evidence (INPUT: Artifact >24mo -> ENGINE: flag AG08, exclude from active window)
tests.expected: AG08 flagged and expired evidence excluded from corroboration
tests.actual: AG08 detected; expired artifact excluded from active window

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG09: Unsupported outcomes (INPUT: O=5 with I=1 -> ENGINE: flag AG09)
tests.expected: AG09 flagged for outcome lacking implementation
tests.actual: AG09 detected: high outcome claim without operational implementation

tests.test: Anti-Gaming Rule AG10: Contradiction suppression (INPUT: D01=80% vs D03=20% -> ENGINE: flag AG10)
tests.expected: AG10 flagged for cross-domain contradiction
tests.actual: AG10 detected and surfaced in assessment audit

tests.test: Cross-Domain Contradiction Detection (D01 high vs D03 low)
tests.expected: At least 1 cross-domain contradiction finding identified

tests.test: Cross-Domain Invariance: Diagnostics have zero mathematical effect on capability scores
tests.expected: D01 Score: 80.00% | Overall: 72.8%
tests.evidence: Cross-domain signals are purely diagnostic and never modify numeric capability scores

tests.test: Response State Integrity (answered, not_sure, not_applicable_requested, not_answered)
tests.expected: All 4 response states stored and handled distinctly server-side

tests.test: Server-Side Authority: Evasive Client Responses Cannot Bypass Evidence Burdens
tests.expected: Server enforces evidence requirements regardless of frontend evasive answers
tests.actual: Server-side validation active in evidence and scoring modules
